text: Oh, I didn't expect to find you here.
...Yes, the the leader of Resistle undercover\nagents asked us to search for the culprit who\nis attacking adventurers, so we came here but...
We thought we wouldn't be able to enter the manor\nusing that excuse. So, we accepted the task to\nget rid of the monsters here...
He said he saw a suspicious shadow and\nhe went after it, but...\nHe hasn't come back...
Oh! You can help me search for my brother?\nThanks. Let's split up and find him.
